title: Test suites
label: Test suites
checked: Every PHP test suite run by scripts/check: saved references from R, lme4, mpmath, Python, and phibble, and phit's own contracts.
description: docs/verifications/run_test_suites.py runs each suite against the release extension and records its exit status and its own summary line. Each row is one suite.
reference: Saved fixtures under tests/fixtures; each lists its generator and versions

inputs.name: Fixture provenance
inputs.detail: generators, versions, hashes, and tolerance policies

comparison.applies_to: Exact results; results, row accounting, parsed values, types, errors
Model matrices; columns, terms, and rows exact; lm and glm fits 1e-9 + 1e-7·|r|
Mixed-model estimates; likelihood 5e-6 + 1e-9·|r|; glmer as in the binomial mixed model
Exposure intercept and standard error; likelihood and counts 1e-9
Distribution functions; logarithms relative to max(1, |r|), quantiles 1e-15 + 1e-12·|r|
Descriptive statistics and smoothing; zeros, ECDF counts, and type-7 identities exact
Sampling; ChaCha uniforms and discrete samples exact
Posterior-draw kernels; moments, covariance maps, affine draws, log determinants
Extreme inputs; per-case tolerances in tests/fixtures/stress-r.json
